description: This file is a code-behind for the 'EditTheory.aspx' page in an ASP.NET Web Forms application. It manages navigation and course selection dropdowns for an online examination system's administrative interface.

classes.name: EditTheory
classes.description: Partial class for the EditTheory ASPX page, handling user interactions and dynamic dropdown population.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently empty.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.name: searchB_Click
methods.description: Stores selected course in session variable '_CRS'.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out user by transferring to the login page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on selected semester.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Event handler for semester dropdown change; refreshes course list accordingly.
